inputs.text: They’re pushing Terry Pheto and the alleged R20.56 million National Lotteries Commission scandal into the spotlight, but that may be the point: give the public one recognizable face to focus on while the institutions involved shape what gets said and what stays hidden. The claims surfaced at the Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. A briefing and an SIU probe don’t tell us the whole story—and the more they insist this is about one person, the more I’d ask whose interests that framing serves.
